provenance.notes: Standard-library tests use a fake SkyPilot SDK and a temporary evidence directory. No Kubernetes or runtime workload result is implied.

covered: Empty and partial multinode captures cannot report success.
Multinode UIDs, namespace, roles, cluster labels and sibling owners are checked.
Runtime success and mapping success are recorded independently.
Managed metadata must cover every submitted job ID with matching task metadata.
Partial runtime job sets cannot report managed probe success.
